scenarios.scenario_abstract: While learning to use a washing machine, [X] separates undershirts, graphic tees, black shirts, a hoodie, gym clothes, and delicate upper garments from towels and jeans, then chooses water, agitation, and drying by fabric behavior and checks which tops fade, shrink, wrinkle, lose stretch, retain odor, or suffer abrasion in a mixed load.
examples: keeping thin tees away from heavy towels that rub during agitation
air-drying an elastic gym top instead of exposing it to heat
using post-wash wrinkles, softness, odor, and recovery to refine future material choices
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 学习使用洗衣机时，[X]会把汗衫、印花 T 恤、深色衬衫、连帽上衣、运动上衣和精细上装与毛巾、牛仔裤分开，再依据面料表现选择水温、搅动和干燥方式，并观察哪些上装会褪色、缩水、起皱、失去弹性、残留异味或在混洗中被磨损。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: After cooking oil lands on a known everyday top, [X] needs to act before the mark sets. The garment's actual material and care label determine how much oil to blot, which grease treatment is safe, the hottest permitted rinse, whether color protection is needed, and why the top must air-dry and be inspected before any heat is used.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 现有的日常上装沾到食用油后，[X]需要在油渍定型前立即处理；该上装的真实材质和洗标决定先吸去多少油分、哪种去油处理安全、可使用的最高水温、是否需要保护颜色，以及为何必须先风干检查再接触热源。
examples: following the actual Cotton garment and its care label rather than generalizing from another top
reducing water temperature or treatment strength when a blend, dye, or trim changes what the owned garment tolerates
not transferring the same spot-treatment sequence to Silk, Wool, Leather, or other sensitive construction without separate evidence

scenarios.scenario_abstract: When turning a garment imagined in the mind into a sketch, reference set, pattern, and muslin, [X] narrows the first project toward a simple top and compares materials by drape, stretch, opacity, edge fraying, sewing stability, expected shrinkage, and whether the finished surface can hold the intended neckline, sleeves, and silhouette.
examples: testing a cheap muslin before cutting the final material
choosing a stable beginner-friendly fabric when a slippery surface defeats accurate seams
washing a sample first to reveal shrinkage or distortion before revising the pattern
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 把脑中的服装形象转成草图、参考图、纸样和坯布样衣时，[X]会把首个项目收敛到简单上装，并比较候选材质的垂坠、弹性、透光性、毛边、缝制稳定性、预期缩水，以及成品表面能否支撑目标领口、袖子和廓形。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While shopping from Ireland for sustainable, chic-but-comfortable summer tops for an Italian holiday, [X] compares how materials breathe, drape, crease, feel on warm skin, survive repeated wear, and remain presentable enough to move from humid cobblestone sightseeing and church visits to dinner.
examples: choosing an airy blouse that still covers the shoulders at a church
checking whether a loose top becomes rumpled or clingy after a long humid walk
weighing natural-fiber feel and longevity against easier washing and faster drying
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 从爱尔兰为意大利假期选购可持续、舒适又雅致的夏季上装时，[X]面对湿热天气、石板路步行、教堂参观和晚餐，会比较候选材质的透气、垂坠、起皱、贴肤感、重复穿着表现，以及能否从白天观光自然过渡到晚餐。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a week-long forest camp with friends, [X] builds an upper-body system from a moisture-managing base, insulating middle layer, and waterproof shell, judging materials by what happens after sweat, rain, cold evenings, cooking smoke, repeated wear, and limited drying rather than treating the warmest or most natural option as automatically best.
examples: avoiding a base layer that stays wet after exertion
keeping insulation useful during a damp cold evening
checking whether the same top can dry and be worn again without severe odor or chafing
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 与朋友进行一周森林露营时，[X]会用排湿打底、保温中层和防水外层搭建上身系统，并依据出汗、下雨、寒冷夜晚、炊烟、重复穿着和有限晾晒后的真实表现判断材质，而不是默认最暖或最天然的选择就一定最好。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: After noticing rapid facial redness on sunny days, [X] adds a lightweight high-collar or hooded sun top to shade, a wide-brimmed hat, cooling water, and trigger avoidance, comparing materials by physical coverage, heat buildup, sweat handling, skin feel, and whether protection remains tolerable during repeated outdoor use.
examples: using a breathable long-sleeve barrier without worsening heat flushing
noticing irritation where a damp collar repeatedly touches sensitive skin
comparing visible redness on otherwise similar outings with consistent upper-body coverage
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 发现晴天外出时面部很快发红后，[X]会把轻薄高领或带帽防晒上装加入遮阴、宽檐帽、冷水降温和避开诱因的方案，并通过物理覆盖、积热、排汗、贴肤感以及能否长期耐受来比较材质。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: During a long-distance relocation made mostly by public transport, [X] limits clothing to three tops, one jacket, and a first-night change that must fit into two small bags, comparing materials by packed weight, compressibility, wrinkle recovery, washing speed, drying time, repeated comfort, and whether the bulkiest layer can be worn through transfers.
examples: washing a tiny rotation instead of carrying several slow-drying backups
keeping one soft top accessible for the first night without unpacking every bag
rejecting a material that saves no space and only serves one part of the journey
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 主要依靠公共交通进行长途搬家时，[X]会把衣物限制为三件上装、一件夹克和一套首夜换洗，并要求它们装进两个小包；材质会根据打包重量、压缩性、抗皱恢复、洗涤与晾干速度、重复穿着舒适度，以及最厚外层能否直接穿过多次换乘来比较。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a casual optometrist visit at about 1 C to try luxury frames, [X] chooses a polished upper-body combination that stays warm outdoors but leaves the face and neckline clear indoors, comparing a substantial winter coat and neat knit layer with a lighter trench-based system by insulation, bulk, finish, and comfort while repeatedly taking glasses on and off.
examples: keeping the neckline smooth so it does not crowd the frames during fitting
choosing enough insulation for the trip without overheating in the shop
using the material's surface and structure to support a clean understated appearance
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在约 1 摄氏度的天气里去验光店试戴奢华镜框时，[X]会选择一套既能在户外保暖、又能在室内让脸部与领口保持清晰的上身搭配，并通过保温、体积、表面质感和反复摘戴眼镜时的舒适度，比较厚实冬季外套加整洁针织层，与较轻的风衣叠穿体系。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: On a cool cloudy day, [X] draws on limited styling experience to try a T-shirt, crewneck sweatshirt, or hoodie beneath an owned thin black bomber jacket and observes how the materials change warmth, wind blocking, collar bunching, shoulder structure, softness, and comfort when the jacket is zipped, opened, or removed.
examples: keeping the bomber's unknown actual fiber unchanged rather than guessing it
comparing a smooth light base with a warmer but bulkier sweatshirt
checking whether hood and collar fabrics press or slide when both layers move
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在凉爽多云的一天，[X]虽然不熟悉穿搭，仍会在已有的薄黑色飞行夹克内搭配 T 恤、圆领卫衣或连帽上衣，并观察这些材质组合在夹克拉上、敞开或脱下时如何改变保暖、防风、领口堆叠、肩部结构、柔软度和舒适度。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a relaxed fifteen-day route through Lucerne, Interlaken, and Montreux with a 15 kg carry-on limit and laundry about every five days, [X] builds a small top rotation for lake breezes, alpine chill, rain, trains, easy walks, and dinners, comparing materials by odor control, quick drying, layering warmth, bulk, and presentability across uses.
examples: repeating one base top between laundry stops without it becoming unpleasant
packing a light insulating layer that does not consume the carry-on
keeping one upper layer neat enough for both a boat ride and an evening meal
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在一趟经卢塞恩、因特拉肯和蒙特勒的 15 日休闲行程中，受 15 公斤随身行李限制、约每五天洗一次衣服时，[X]会为湖风、山地低温、雨天、列车、轻松步行和晚餐建立小型上装轮换，并通过抑味、快干、叠穿保暖、体积和多次穿着后的体面程度比较材质。

professional_scenarios.scenario_abstract: While preparing a small online clothing store that will hold and print its own stock, a creator orders a narrow set of blank T-shirts, sweatshirts, and hoodies from authorized suppliers, then wash-tests and decorates the samples to compare material weight, hand feel, shrinkage, stitching, color consistency, printability, post-print comfort, and reliable restocking before committing inventory.
examples: measuring the same blank before and after its first wash
rejecting a soft sample whose surface or stretch makes the chosen print method fail
choosing a stable material and supplier only after a small decorated test run
professional_scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在筹备一家自行备货和印花的小型服装网店时，创作者从授权供应商订购少量空白 T 恤、卫衣和连帽上衣样品，再进行洗涤和印制测试，比较材质克重、手感、缩水、缝线、颜色一致性、可印性、印后舒适度和稳定补货能力，之后才决定库存。
